component.name: Chiron
component.summary: Linux game library frontend — AppImage for emulators and GOG (Heroic/Proton)

description.p: Chiron is a Linux game library frontend. One AppImage to browse your collection and launch emulators, native games, and GOG titles—including Windows/Proton installs managed by Heroic or Dark1HGL.

Shipped only as a Linux x86_64 AppImage. Linux GOG discovery supports Heroic / Dark1HGL installs (including Proton) and native ~/GOG Games start.sh layouts. Themes remain compatible with the Pegasus Frontend format.
More reliable Linux GOG launching from the AppImage: cleaner game startups, better Heroic/Dark1HGL helper picking, and fixes for missing or duplicate installs.
Hardened Linux GOG/Heroic discovery and launch, AppImage packaging, and first public Chiron release notes.
